a.lede: From retro cassette players and virtual notebooks to flight trackers and even a digital toaster, developers are finding creative ways to take advantage of Apple's first foldable iPhone.
a.title: These clever apps show off the iPhone Duo’s potential

b.lede: Photos shared online showed faults appearing on the screens of Apple's first foldable device.
b.title: Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo handsets with screen problems
